description: Public experiment definitions only. Keep merchant exports and private operational readings outside the repository.

bets.metric: Per DE/NL/AU category cohort: human page_view events, need_selected, need_result, merchant outbound. Exclude QA, bots and DNT/GPC. Merchant-confirmed net commissions remain a separate source.
bets.threshold: First 30 live days: at least 100 qualified visits per market before judging content; then >=10 guide-result clicks and >=5 merchant clicks is a continuation signal, not statistical proof or revenue. No reach = distribution inconclusive.
bets.win: Deepen the market/constraint with measured demand. Monetize NL/AU only after verified local affiliate enrollment and tracking ID. Validate EPC from matched merchant reports before scaling.
bets.lose: If >=100 qualified visits and no guide-result or merchant clicks, revise entry intent and buying fit once; do not add more pages to that cluster. Unknown attribution or commissions blocks revenue claims.
bets.queue_note: The measurement/placement part of this older unbuilt topic is delivered by this public pilot. Recheck cannibalization before any separate calibration page; do not duplicate the measurement guide.

bets.metric: Qualified visits by page/country; consented GA4 tool_complete/tool_export and affiliate_click. Example runs are excluded. Merchant-confirmed revenue is separate.
bets.threshold: 28 days: fewer than 100 qualified cohort visits = insufficient reach; with at least 100 visits, 10 confirmed completions or 5 merchant clicks is a continuation signal, not statistical proof.
bets.win: Deepen observed useful paths; verify matching merchant revenue before calling this commercial success.
bets.lose: If reach is sufficient and outcomes absent, revise intent and discovery once before adding further pages.

bets.metric: Workshop GA4 pageviews and fixed eco_workshop_decision/export/official/shop/stl actions, by tool_id. Exclude QA, automation and opt-outs. Shop intent is not a purchase; STL export is not fit-tested delivery. Merchant commissions require separate matching merchant reports.
bets.threshold: At least 100 relevant visits before judging utility; then at least 10 deliberate decisions and 3 checklist or STL exports support further user research. These are operating gates, not statistical proof. Low reach is inconclusive.
bets.win: Deepen the observed task with reliable model evidence and actual household fit feedback. Paid files require separate delivery acceptance and real buyers; no checkout is introduced.
bets.lose: At sufficient reach with no decisions, revise the task entry once. With decisions but no useful follow-through, do not add model databases or subscriptions. Pool seasonality must be separated from repair use.

bets.start_rule: First full property-timezone day after successful production verification; do not use this file date as experiment start.
bets.metric: DE and NL separately: organic landing sessions and engaged sessions on the listed pages. Search Console country/query/page impressions and clicks reported separately. Tool examples, deliberate calculations, guide openings and affiliate events remain distinct. No event/user conversion ratio.
bets.layout: Single product rollout; staggered observational comparison, not a randomized A/B experiment. Do not pool countries or sources. Keep analytics version and release timestamp in the observation record.
bets.observation: At least 14 complete days after verified release and analytics processing; review at 28 days. Missing reach or attribution is inconclusive, not zero demand or revenue.
bets.threshold: Do not expand a new country cluster from page publication alone. Require repeated country-relevant organic arrivals and deliberate use in two complete 14-day windows; this is an operating continuation gate, not proof of causal uplift.
bets.win: Deepen the observed local intent on existing URLs. New model URLs additionally require fresh exact-model same-country demand evidence and source facts.
bets.lose: If reach is low, inspect discovery and indexing before adding URLs. If relevant arrivals exist but no useful actions, revise decision usefulness and navigation. Never infer failed sales without readable matched merchant reports.
bets.revenue: Unknown until authorized merchant reports provide commission status, refunds, currency and attribution window. No hypothetical EPC.
bets.rollback: Revert this scoped change if page, calculation, privacy or publishing regression appears. Preserve truthful source corrections; do not restart the paused Growth Loop.
bets.due_note: Reminder only. Compute day 14 and day 28 after the first full Asia/Shanghai day following verified deployment; analytics processing delay applies.

bets.goal: Improve useful winter decisions and qualified merchant hand-offs on existing German-language URLs. No revenue claim without readable matched merchant reports.

rounds.goal: Prioritise decision gaps over page count
rounds.evidence: DE GA4 2026-10-24 through 10-30: 20 sessions / 16 engaged versus 21 / 12 in prior7d; small sample. Existing cold-room and laundry tools already cover generic choices. Public October forum questions about desk warmth and valve adapters are qualitative signals, not demand volume.
rounds.acceptance: Deepen existing personal-warmth, thermostat-fit and winter-entry URLs; do not create country/model doorway pages.

rounds.evidence: A rated wattage is not measured draw; automatic shut-off varies by exact model; identical valve thread is not proof of fit across thermostat families; EUR estimates and Amazon.de eligibility do not establish Swiss suitability.
rounds.acceptance: Separate examples from edited calculations, preserve no-purchase/unknown-fit outcomes, retain official exact-generation references and explicit DE/AT/CH assumptions.

rounds.evidence: Scoped GA4 bridge did not admit winter wall-moisture taupunkt_check; that does not prove absence from first-party records. Existing weekly traffic cannot support a useful three-market A/B revenue test.
rounds.acceptance: Math, compatibility, mobile/no-JS, opt-out, metadata and Markdown checks pass. Verify deployed assets and applicable IndexNow receipt. Observe real traffic for full14d before judging utility.

bets.metric: Country-specific landing sessions and engaged_sessions; eco_country_scenario_open, eco_warmth_example/calculate/share, eco_valve_result/official/share, eco_dewpoint_example/check and affiliate_click separately. Each scoped event is deduplicated once per page, not a unique user, session, compatible installation, buyer or order. Do not compute a click-session rate until same-scope clicked sessions are available.
bets.layout: Single product rollout with an observational before/after comparison, not randomized A/B. DE, AT, CH and sources remain separate. Event coverage changed: new events cannot be compared to historical zeros.
bets.start_rule: Record exact production verification, current asset hashes and GA4 property timezone Asia/Shanghai. Start at the first complete property day after verified deployment; allow source latency. Prior EU experiment has overlapping German routes/discovery: annotate overlap, no isolated causal claim.
bets.observation: Observe14 complete days; review28. Consent exclusions, QA filters, Google processing delay and small samples constrain inference. Search Console impressions/clicks are a separate acquisition stage and use their own source timezone.
bets.win: Continue only with repeated relevant arrivals plus deliberate tool use or official/merchant hand-offs. Operating signals are not proof of growth or revenue. Actual net commissions require matched authorized merchant evidence.
bets.lose: Low impressions: investigate discovery/indexing. Impressions without arrivals: inspect query/title intent. Relevant arrivals without use: revise entry/tool usefulness. Use without merchant clicks: investigate fit and no-purchase outcomes. Clicks without readable orders: sales outcome remains unknown. Do not expand model/country URL counts to manufacture an update.
bets.ab_followup: Do not launch an underpowered multi-country test now. Once the stable event baseline supports a pre-specified sample-size calculation, test one DE entry-copy variable with a fixed assignment and unchanged tool/factual content. Primary outcome: same-scope sessions with a deliberate tool decision; affiliate sessions secondary, verified net commission separately. Pre-register baseline, detectable effect, sample size and stopping rule;14 days alone is not a significance threshold.
publication_acceptance: Existing canonical URLs and reciprocal hreflang where real translations exist; do not invent regional alternates.
Crawlable home/hub/tool links, useful factual HTML and Markdown mirrors with formulas and official sources; no unsupported product ratings or tested claims.
Disclosed optional affiliate links; explicit store/delivery/currency limits; no automatic marketplace rewrite.
Existing GA4 property and opt-out/QA/DNT/GPC/private-page exclusions; fixed action names only, no raw input or shared URL analytics.
Run existing IndexNow cadence for authored URL changes; receipt is not proof of indexing. No per-push extra submitter.
bets.revenue: Unknown: no successful read of authorized fulfilled-commission/order/refund report. Key-event zero is not zero revenue; no invented sales, commission or EPC.
bets.rollback: Revert scoped behavioral regressions; keep factual corrections. No Growth Loop restart, new spend, outreach, social publishing, membership/payment configuration, storage/PV or Growatt restoration.
bets.due_note: Reminder only; calculate day14/day28 from actual verified deployment rather than this JSON date.
bets.threshold: First observe14 complete days; fewer than100 relevant landing sessions per market over28d is insufficient reach, not a failed offer. At sufficient reach, at least10 deliberate tool interactions and5 official/merchant hand-offs supports further investigation, not statistical or revenue proof. Keep actions separate and never add them as unique buyers. Two full14d windows with repeated useful paths precede further model/country expansion.
